comment: The filing path's one-value-per-namespace refusal (`fix-issue-filing-state-namespace`, issue #179), and the two required fields that are labels (issue #201). At filing time there is nothing to displace, so a merged label set naming two values of one namespace is a refusal, not the replacement `update.sh` performs for the state namespace; and because `create.sh` insists on a finding's `class` and `category`, both join the label set — the mutation that removes the join must be visible in the case that asserts it. Run it with `bash tools/mutate.sh --mutations tools/create-mutations.json`; `.pi/skills/mutation-runner` owns how, `.pi/skills/revert-check` owns the rule, and the CI step that owns the issue tooling prints `--list`, so a set that no longer parses fails the pipeline instead of rotting. The search is a single line and unique in its file (the runner's replacement is literal and line-based).

mutations.why: a filing whose merged label set names two values of one namespace being refused before any gh issue create
the filing path refusing a citation that repeats its own directory, so the item is not born stale (#189)
the finding's required class and category reaching the tracker as labels (issue #201), so a finding that names its kind only in the two fields cannot file an item no selector reads
